mapper.select: insert into builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history (frd_screen_id, html, changes) values (#{frdScreenId}, #{html}, #{changes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) returning id

insert into builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history (frd_screen_id, html, md, changes, operation_id, source, tobe_document_state, tobe_document_updated_at) values (#{frdScreenId}, #{html}, #{md,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{changes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operationId}, 'FRD_CANVAS_AI', case when #{md,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null or btrim(#{md,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) = '' then 'NOT_REQUESTED' else 'SUCCEEDED' end, case when #{md,jdbcType=VARCHAR} is null or btrim(#{md,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) = '' then null else now() end) returning id

select h.id, h.frd_screen_id, s.screen_id, s.screen_name, h.html, h.md, h.changes, h.operation_id, h.source, h.created_at from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history h join builder.adk_builder_frd_screen s on s.id = h.frd_screen_id where s.frd_id = #{frdId} order by h.created_at desc, h.id desc

select h.id, h.frd_screen_id, s.screen_id, s.screen_name, h.html, h.md, h.changes, h.operation_id, h.source, h.created_at from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history h join builder.adk_builder_frd_screen s on s.id = h.frd_screen_id where h.id = #{id}

select h.id, h.frd_screen_id, s.screen_id, s.screen_name, h.html, h.md, h.changes, h.operation_id, h.source, h.created_at from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history h join builder.adk_builder_frd_screen s on s.id = h.frd_screen_id where h.frd_screen_id = #{frdScreenId} order by h.created_at desc, h.id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history set md = #{md}, tobe_document_state = 'SUCCEEDED', tobe_document_failure = null, tobe_document_updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and md is null
mapper.select: select tobe_document_state as state, tobe_document_failure as failure, tobe_document_updated_at as "updatedAt" from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history set tobe_document_state = #{state}, tobe_document_failure = #{failure,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, tobe_document_updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
